newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FOREST'S ROY SET TO JOIN HERTHA BERLIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FOREST'S ROY SET TO JOIN HERTHA BERLIN.

text.p: Dutch international striker Brian Roy looks set to leave Nottingham Forest for Bundesliga newcomers Hertha Berlin, the premier league side said on Thursday.
Forest confirmed that Roy had met representatives from the German club and had apparently reached an agreement over personal terms. The two clubs were also close to agreeing a transfer figure.
"I would envisage that would be decided in the next 48 hours and if everything is okay Brian will be joining the German club," Bassett said.
Roy joined Forest in 1994 from Italian side Foggia but asked for a move after spending most of the 1996-97 season on the fringes of the first team.
